dbSNP4Bioc: build, cache, and query dbSNP VCF data as Parquet

Source: R/dbSNP4Bioc-package.R
dbSNP4Bioc-package.Rd

Converts a single chromosome of an NCBI dbSNP VCF (as distributed, bgzipped and tabix-indexed) into a slim, sorted Parquet representation with dbsnp_build_chrom(), caches it with BiocFileCache::BiocFileCache(), and exposes the cached resource as a lazy dplyr/dbplyr table with dbsnp_tbl() so that rsID and genomic-position lookups can be expressed with ordinary dplyr::filter() / dplyr::select() pipelines.

Workflow

  1. Set the environment variable DBSNP_GCF_PATH to the bgzipped, tabix-indexed dbSNP VCF (e.g. GCF_000001405.40.gz, with GCF_000001405.40.gz.tbi next to it).

  2. Call dbsnp_build_chrom() once per chromosome of interest; this populates the local BiocFileCache.

  3. Call dbsnp_tbl() (or the convenience wrapper dbsnp_in_range()) to query the cache with dplyr verbs.
